evidence.why: This second setWindowOpenHandler call overwrites the first allowlist-enforcing handler (line 73-127). Electron keeps only the last registered handler, so the exact-hostname allowlist is never actually applied to the child window's nested window.open events; instead shell.openExternal runs on any https URL with no hostname restriction, effectively bypassing the allowlist that the comments claim is enforced.

controls_present: contextBridge exposes only closed function set
other_classes_observed: Duplicate setWindowOpenHandler registration silently discards the first handler (logic bug / dead code), contradicting the security comments about an exact hostname allowlist
